name: Sustainable Catalyst Workspace v0.56.0 — Research Automation Framework
features: hardens the public beta around real-world browser, storage, recovery, and deployment conditions before adding another major subsystem
adds local Field Diagnostics for browser capabilities, workspace size, storage probe latency, serialization/parse latency, DOM density, recovery snapshot state, and deployment profile
adds explicit advisory thresholds for attention signals without a health score or automated judgment
adds user-generated issue report export with observed behavior, expected behavior, reproduction steps, issue type, and impact
adds a portable text support summary for low-friction troubleshooting
keeps diagnostic exports privacy-minimized: no project content, object text, source URLs, device identifier, query string, or hash is added automatically
adds no automatic issue submission, telemetry, or hidden repair channel
keeps storage schema 27 and project schema 12.0 unchanged; no data migration is required
retains the v0.30 Start experience, guest-first access, explicit account backup/sync, and human-controlled lifecycle governance
Notebook Collections & Knowledge Linking
grounded notebook questions
citation-required answer review
portable assistance request/response
explicit draft materialization
adds notebook-level Change Review from explicit notebook snapshots without a hidden score
adds selective notebook reconciliation that creates a new notebook copy and preserves both source states
adds a derived notebook audit history from authoritative notebook records rather than a shadow ledger
adds source-lineage inspection across capture provenance, explicit links, promotions, synthesis, assistance, restore points, and sync state

Collaboration Architecture Foundation: explicit local actors, ownership policies, role grants, canonical-target comments, review proposals, and shareable-project contracts without server permission simulation.

Institutional Research Packages: explicit frozen disclosure bundles for selected research, recorded provenance, citations, task context, and collaboration review context without source-project mutation or automatic publication.
summary: Collaboration Architecture Foundation formalizes local actors, project ownership, descriptive role grants, canonical-target comments, review proposals, and content-free shareable-project contracts without live co-editing or automatic source mutation.
